connectEtsy.title: Connect an Etsy shop
connectEtsy.description: Connect your Etsy shop so Podivo can prepare and publish listings from your workspace.
connectEtsy.step1: Open API keys from the Workspace menu and select Add API key.
connectEtsy.step2: Choose Etsy and start the connection flow.
connectEtsy.step3: Sign in to the correct Etsy account and approve the requested permissions.
connectEtsy.step4: Return to Podivo and confirm that the connection status is Connected.
connectEtsy.note: Use the Etsy account that owns the shop you want Podivo to publish to.

fixApiKey.title: Fix an API key
fixApiKey.description: A key usually needs attention when it expired, was revoked, or no longer has the permissions Podivo requires.
fixApiKey.step1: Open API keys and find the provider that needs attention.
fixApiKey.step2: Confirm the key is still active in the provider account and has the required permissions.
fixApiKey.step3: Select Edit, paste the replacement key, and save your changes.
fixApiKey.step4: Run the connection check again and confirm the status is Connected.
fixApiKey.note: For security, Podivo only displays the masked credential. Never include a full API key in a support ticket.

credits.title: Understand credits
credits.description: Your plan includes an allowance used by generation and publishing activity in the workspace.
credits.step1: Open Usage to review images, videos, listings, and estimated provider costs.
credits.step2: Use the date-range selector to compare activity across different periods.
credits.step3: Check Credit allowance to see the amount used, the plan limit, and the reset date.
credits.step4: Open Billing if you need to review or change the subscription attached to the workspace.
credits.note: Usage data can take a short time to appear after a workflow finishes.
